senses.gloss: (b. h.; sec. r. of רוץ)to quicken.
to be made rapid, to flow rapidly in a gutter.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Parah 9:8">Tosef. Par. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Parah 8:8">VIII</cite>), 8 <he>המים הנמשכין והנִמְרָצִין</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>והנגררין</he>, v. <cite ref="N00184"><he>נָגַר</he></cite>; R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 9:5">Par. IX, 5</cite> <he>והנזרקין</he>) water running slowly in a channel or rapidly in a gutter.

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (play on <he>נ̇מ̇ר̇ץ̇</he>, <cite ref="Micah 2:10">Mic. II, 10</cite>) <he>נ̇ואף מ̇מזר וכ׳</he>; <cite ref="Shabbat 105a">Sabb. 105ᵃ</cite> (play on <he>נ̇מ̇ר̇צ̇ת</he>, <cite ref="I Kings 2:8">I Kings II, 8</cite>), v. <cite ref="N00351"><he>נוֹטָרִיקוֹן</he></cite>.
